# VEXI

> VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial. A demo runs in your browser with no account.

The short form of this file is https://vexi.app/llms.txt; the sitemap is https://vexi.app/sitemap.xml.

## What VEXI makes

- **Type what you want. It comes back finished.** Posts, videos, designs and captions, made in the conversation. Cut, with B-roll and captions, without opening an editor. Say what you wanted instead and it remakes it.
- **It writes it, designs it and puts it out.** Posts at the times your audience actually shows up. Approve everything, or let it run on its own. Set how designed the posts should look and it holds that mix.
- **Tap anything on the design to change it.** Headline, photo, logo, colors, QR code. Your brand files and voice applied every time. No layers, no canvas, no export settings.
- **One still becomes a moving clip.** A photo turns into motion, sized for the feed. Pick a look and it re-cuts to match. Comes back ready to post.
- **One long video. The best clips back.** Upload a long raw recording, like a podcast. Get back the clips that work best, captioned. Music is laid under the cut, matched to every clip.
- **Show it a video you like.** Drop a clip, or paste a link — if a platform blocks the link, drop the file instead. VEXI studies the pacing, captions and energy, then makes yours the same way. Your words, your footage, never theirs.
- **Read. Record. Ship.** Tell it what the script should do and it writes it. Your script rolls on screen while you record. Three-second countdown before it starts.
- **Know what people are searching.** Pulled from YouTube, Google and TikTok. Ranked by how popular each search is. One tap turns an idea into a script or a post.
- **Numbers that tell you what to do next.** Plain-English notes on what is working. It finds the times your audience shows up. Every number in one place — performance, content, reports.

## Plans and prices

- **Creator, $199 a month.** Social media, handled. Ask for anything, get it made, and let Autopilot put it out. Monthly usage for posts, videos and designs. Video editing, scripts and teleprompter. Autopilot writes, designs and posts 5 times a week. 2 social accounts included; add more for $10/mo each. 1:1 setup call included.
- **Pro, $399 a month.** Everywhere, every day. Everything in Creator. 3× Creator's monthly usage. Autopilot posts every day. 4 social accounts included; add more for $10/mo each. 1:1 setup call included.
- **Max, $599 a month.** Your own media company. Everything in Pro. 5× Creator's monthly usage. Autopilot posts twice a day. 8+ social accounts included; add more for $10/mo each. 1:1 setup call included.
- **Trial.** Every plan starts with 15 days. Cancel before it ends and you are not charged. Card up front. Everything unlocked. One trial per customer.
- Need more? Add usage anytime: $10, $25, $50, $100 or an amount you choose. Added usage never expires.
- Going over your plan is off.
- At 80% and 90% of your monthly usage, the app tells you. At 100%, new pieces pause. A piece already in progress always finishes.
- Unused monthly usage does not roll over.
- Pay yearly in the app: $133/mo instead of $199 — equivalent to 4 months free, $1,592 billed yearly.
- Cancel anytime. No contracts.

## Questions people ask

- **What does VEXI make?** Reels, posts, captions and scripts, plus long-form videos on every plan. Videos come back cut, with B-roll and captions, sized for each platform. Send a long recording like a podcast and get its best clips back.
- **Do I need editing skills?** No. You describe what you want in chat and it comes back finished. To change something, tap it on the design or ask.
- **Where does it post?** Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile, posted for you.
- **Will it post without asking me?** Only if you let it. Autopilot can wait for your approval on everything, or run on its own and post at the times that perform.
- **What if I do not like what it made?** Say what you wanted instead and it remakes it. With approvals on, nothing goes out until you are happy with it.
- **Is there a free trial?** Every plan starts with a 15-day trial. You can also run the demo without an account or a card before you get that far.
- **Is this the real app?** The demo is the app — the same chat and the same engines in guest mode, inside a fixed allowance. The walkthrough film is built from the app's screens.
- **How long does it actually take?** The demo runs at real speed. The chat shows its progress as it works.
- **Do I need to film anything first?** No. You can start from a photo, a clip, a link, or nothing at all and describe what you want.
- **Can I try it without an account?** Yes. Type a request on the homepage and it opens the real app in your browser, with limits.
- **What does it post to?** Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and your Google Business Profile.
- **Does it post without me?** Only if you let it. Autopilot can wait for your approval on everything.
- **Will it look like my brand?** It uses your logo, colors, fonts and the way you write. You set how designed you want posts to look and it holds that mix.
- **Do you help me get set up?** Yes. Every plan includes a 1:1 setup call. Start your trial, then book the call from inside VEXI; the Welcome chat gets you started in the meantime.

## Security

- **We never hold your passwords.** Every platform connection uses that platform's own sign-in. We never see or store your passwords. Revoke it on the platform and posting stops.
- **In transit.** HTTPS everywhere. Your platforms' sign-in tokens are held by our publishing provider, not in your VEXI account.
- **Not used to train models.** We don't train models on your content. Your uploads are used to make your pieces and nothing else.
- **Who on our team can see your data.** Staff access to client accounts is logged.
- **Where it is stored.** Our hosting region and the kinds of providers that handle your data are listed in the privacy policy, and we update it before a new kind is added.
- **Reporting a vulnerability.** Found something? Send it to us before you publish it and we will confirm receipt, fix it, and credit you if you want.

## Posts and articles

- [Black-hat watch: the social media tricks people are trying right now, and what happens to the accounts](https://vexi.app/blog/black-hat-social-media-tricks-2026): Pods, comment bots, sub4sub, bought views, AI fake customers, stuffed GBP names, review gating and reupload farms: what the rules say and what happens.
- [AI video editing, explained for a business: what it does well, what it still can’t, and how to use it](https://vexi.app/blog/ai-video-editing-explained): What AI video editing does well (cuts, captions, reframing, eye contact), where it still fails, how to brief an AI editor, and where a person still wins.
- [Service as software](https://vexi.app/blog/service-as-software): Software used to hand you a tool. VEXI does the work: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits and posts, and Autopilot fills your week ahead.
- [How to make a social video with ChatGPT, step by step (the hard way)](https://vexi.app/blog/make-a-social-video-with-chatgpt): The real ChatGPT video pipeline, step by step: script, voice, visuals, edit, cover and schedule. What each step takes, what it costs, and the shortcut.
- [Is AI replacing the videographer and the content creator?](https://vexi.app/blog/is-ai-replacing-the-videographer): For most businesses' social content, the hiring is going away. Where a human videographer still wins, and what changes when a shoot becomes a request.
- [YouTube growth tricks that work right now, for Shorts and long-form](https://vexi.app/blog/youtube-growth-tricks-that-work): YouTube growth tricks for Shorts and long-form: thumbnail tests, end screens, chapters, Shorts funnels, and the gray-area hacks with their honest risk.
- [Instagram and TikTok growth tricks: what works, and what gets accounts restricted](https://vexi.app/blog/instagram-and-tiktok-growth-tricks): Instagram and TikTok growth tricks that work: hooks, trial reels, collabs, search keywords, audio. Plus pods, follow/unfollow and bought views, and the risks.
- [Google Business Profile ranking tricks for a local business, and the ones that get you suspended](https://vexi.app/blog/google-business-profile-ranking-tricks): Google Business Profile ranking tricks for local businesses: categories, services, photos, posts and real reviews. Plus the black-hat moves that get suspended.
- [How to make a social video with Claude, step by step (the hard way)](https://vexi.app/blog/make-a-social-video-with-claude): The real Claude video route: script, connectors to Canva, Zapier and n8n, voice, visuals, edit and schedule. Time and cost per step, and the shortcut.
- [How to make a social video with Gemini, step by step (the hard way)](https://vexi.app/blog/make-a-social-video-with-gemini): The real Gemini video route: script, Omni and Veo clips, Flow, edit, captions, cover and schedule. Time and cost per step, and the shortcut.
